text:
alex chen: Quick rollcall — prepping ORCH tenant (customer: MeridianHealth) for private rollout next Wed. I want a short status on three things: 1) egress/NAT fallback, 2) airgapped image sync, 3) terraform PR + KMS access. Who's owning what?

maria rodriguez: I'm owning image sync. last night I validated digest signing and the mirror script, but still seeing a permissions error when pulling from the staging registry inside the airgapped env. error: "pull access denied for redwood-registry/staging, repository does not exist or may require 'docker login'"

pranav singh: Egress/NAT: I've deployed the prober to the tenant staging VPC. Most flows look good but SNI egress for metrics -> datadog is blocked intermittently. Filing a firewall ticket with customer's infra now. ETA for workaround (proxy) ~4h.

jessica parker: Terraform PR #348 for vpc/subnet + route tables is up, awaiting reviews. pinging @ben for security review (KMS IAM changes included). I added the canary rollout flags in the terragrunt config.

ben park: Reviewing tf now. KMS note: need kms:Decrypt on service account for model-cache key. If customer uses their own KMS, we need a key policy change. Reached out to their SecOps to get an exception for the rollout window.

samir patel: Re: image pull perms — maria, can you paste the exact `curl` that fails? I can try from our airgapped jump host. Also have you tried `skopeo`?

maria rodriguez: paste: ``curl -u redwood-ci:$TOKEN https://staging-registry.internal/v2/redwood-registry/staging/manifests/latest`` returns 401 from inside the isolated subnet but works from their bastion. skopeo gives same auth error.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: prober-check completed for tenant-orch-staging at 2026-03-17T09:12:00Z — 2/3 egress checks failed (metrics.sni, updates.checkins). Ticket: INF-6721 created.

alex chen: OK — summary so far: image pull perms is a customer-side auth mapping (maria + samir to triage), egress has a ticket INF-6721 (pranav), terraform pending security signoff (ben) and needs KMS policy from customer. Two quick asks: 1) can we get a short fallback plan if metrics SNI stays blocked at cutover? 2) maria — estimate for image sync unblock?

pranav singh: Fallback plan: enable outbound proxy in tenant routes and add a proxy env in runtime config (low-lift). I'll prepare a one-click proxy toggle and a docs snippet. Can roll out as hotfix before cutover if needed.

maria rodriguez: If SecOps grants registry read for the redwood service principal, we can finish by EOD. Otherwise plan B: we push images to their internal mirror via the jump host (manual step) — ~2h work and one ops runbook step.

ben park: Security signoff ETA: EOD if customer provides KMS policy change by noon their time. Otherwise we'll need to scope a short-lifespan key and update TF to use external_key_id override.

jessica parker: @ben once you approve PR I'll merge and kick the canary. I added the smoke test that validates egress and image pull before promoting.

alex chen: Great. Action items: 
- maria + samir: get registry auth fix (owner: maria) — ETA: EOD or fallback manual mirror (2h).
- pranav: implement proxy toggle + docs (owner: pranav) — ETA: 4h.
- ben: finalize security/KMS (owner: ben) — ETA: by noon customer local time else short-lived key plan.
- jessica: merge TF after ben signoff + run canary tests (owner: jessica) — ETA: after signoff.

alex chen: Quick code-review ping: @ben can you look at the KMS policy snippet in PR #348 line ~120? It's a small IAM binding: ```json
{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01"}
```

ben park: Will review now. If anyone needs to escalate, call me on Signal. :phone:  

maria rodriguez: tagging customer-secops contact @meridian-secops in case they see this thread — we need registry read for redwood-service-principal.

alex chen: OK team — let's reconvene in this thread with any updates. If everything looks green by 17:00 PT we'll proceed with the canary tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ops-bot: reminder: create post-deploy runbook entry for fallback proxy toggle (template: /playbooks/proxy-toggle.md).
